DM (Data Management)

+ Generate analysis datasets, tables, and reports

1 st : Interview (offline) with HR (by English); Discussion of salary expectations and initial
suitability + Test IQ
2 nd : Final interview (Online/Offline) with General Director (by English) in June or July 2026
